description: Source code for 'mtd' - a tool for manipulating memory technology devices (MTD). Includes functions for opening, checking, erasing, writing, verifying, and managing MTD devices, along with command-line interface handling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the mtd manipulation tool, parsing command-line arguments and executing corresponding device operations.

methods.name: mtd_open
methods.description: Opens an MTD device, trying to resolve device number from /proc/mtd if possible.

methods.name: mtd_check_open
methods.description: Checks and opens an MTD device, retrieving device info such as size and type.

methods.name: mtd_block_is_bad
methods.description: Checks if a block at a given offset is marked as bad.

methods.name: mtd_erase_block
methods.description: Erases a block at a specified offset.

methods.name: mtd_write_buffer
methods.description: Writes a buffer to the device at a specified offset.

methods.name: image_check
methods.description: Reads initial bytes to determine image format and performs optional checks.

methods.name: mtd_check
methods.description: Validates and opens the specified MTD device, handling multiple device parts.

methods.name: mtd_unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the specified MTD device or device parts.

methods.name: mtd_erase
methods.description: Erases the entire MTD device, skipping bad blocks.

methods.name: mtd_dump
methods.description: Outputs the contents of the device to stdout.

methods.name: mtd_verify
methods.description: Verifies the device content against a file's MD5 checksum.

methods.name: indicate_writing
methods.description: Displays status message indicating data is being written.

methods.name: mtd_write
methods.description: Writes image data to the device, handling partitioning, bad blocks, and optional FIS layout.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and command options for the tool.

methods.name: do_reboot
methods.description: Reboots the system via system call or command.
